body:
## Summary

Closes the qt4tests **fn-sort-with / array-sort-with cluster (49 tests)** at the frozen `XPath40` level (all 4.0-only, **not** experimental), and takes **fn-compare from 107 exploratory failures to 13**:

- **`fn:compare` PR909 upgrade** (3.1 code path byte-identical): comparands relaxed to `xs:anyAtomicType?` — exact BigInteger cross-numeric ordering (`(double)3.1 > (decimal)3.1`, `(float)3.1 < (decimal)3.1`, `2e0 = 2`), NaN below −INF with NaN = NaN, booleans, hex/base64 by decoded octets, QName by {namespace URI, local}, **all duration subtypes** by the un-normalized (months, days, seconds) tuple (`P2Y > P1000D`, `PT1H = PT60M0.00S`), and g* types on the UTC instant with missing timezone read as the implicit timezone (PR2256 — String-kind g values now bypass the string branch). Mixed incomparable kinds → XPTY0004.
- **`fn:sort-with`**: comparator validation runs *before* the empty-input shortcut (`sort-with((), ())` → XPTY0004).
- **New `array:sort-with#2`**.
- **New `fn:is-NaN#1`**: atomizing (arrays contribute members; maps/functions → FOTY0013; empty/multi → XPTY0004).
- **New `fn:atomic-type-annotation#1`** record: `name` / `is-simple` / `variety` / `base-type()` / `primitive-type()` / `matches($v)` (hierarchy-walking instance-of) / `constructor($v)` (delegates to `VmEngine.Cast`); the XDM-natural type is inferred from the value kind when no explicit annotation is stored (the engine stores annotations sparsely).
- **Parser PR2962**: lookup keys accept variable references (`$map?$var`).
- **Harness**: `DependencyFilter40` marks `typedData` unsupported (no PSVI-typed source nodes); **fn-sort-with + array-sort-with promoted into GatedSets → 215 sets**.

fn-compare remains exploratory: the 13 remaining failures are `#Q{}` URI-qualified literals, destructuring `let $($h,$m)`, and UCA-collation FOCH0002 — each its own future slice.

## Test plan

- [x] `dotnet test Bosak.sln -c Release` — **3,570 passed / 0 failed** (+15 `XPath40FunctionTests`, +18 `VersionGateTests` rows); LanguageServer.Tests 72/72 (separate project)
- [x] QT3 full sweep — **31,142/0/679** exit 0 (`.guard-tmp/qt3-sort-with.log`)
- [x] XSLT smoke (`mode`) — **162/0/26** (`.guard-tmp/xslt-smoke-sort-with.log`)
- [x] qt4 gate-only with final binary — **7,764/0/1,833, 215 gated sets** (`.guard-tmp/qt4-gate-only-sort-with.log`)
- [x] Per-set: fn-sort-with + array-sort-with **49/0/0**; fn-is-NaN **14/0/2** dep-skips; fn-atomic-type-annotation **2/0/4** dep-skips; fn-compare **220/13** exploratory
title: REQ-123 sort-with cluster: fn:compare PR909 upgrade, array:sort-with, fn:is-NaN, fn:atomic-type-annotation
